summary: PR-1371 only reindents controls/mortgage/policy-params.json, and every policy value is unchanged. Because the file is a protected controls path, CHG-6 requires a control_owner approval from someone outside the author's team. The only such approval is from Declan Farrell, who is on the author's team (lending-eng), so CHG-6 is refuted. Separately, the JUnit reports appear to come from a developer machine and are dated after the review time, which leaves the CHG-4 test evidence unestablished. The change is rejected until an independent control owner, for example from the controls-office, approves it and genuine CI evidence is attached.
